## Three things that matter

1. **Nvidia consolidates AI accelerator dominance as AMD's record quarter gets punished**
AMD fell ~6% post-earnings despite a record quarter; Nvidia gained ~4% on a SpaceX partnership nod that implies procurement of over two million Rubin GPUs. The divergence sharpens the comps debate — AMD's multiple looks increasingly capped by execution-gap perception, while Nvidia's pipeline visibility justifies premium pricing. For any semiconductor M&A or equity financing mandate, the bid-ask on AI accelerator assets will remain anchored to Nvidia comparables.

2. **SK Hynix holds more than half the HBM market; AI memory bottleneck may last until 2028**
SK Hynix's dominant HBM share displaces Micron and SanDisk/Western Digital in competitive positioning, with Samsung's new zHBM architecture (claiming 8x HBM5 performance) adding a third credible supplier narrative. A bottleneck persisting to 2028 sustains capex and debt financing demand across the memory supply chain. Equity raises and project-finance structures tied to HBM capacity expansion carry a more durable demand thesis than the market's current short-cycle pricing suggests.

3. **Google's $200B Anthropic financing and Anthropic's move into custom silicon raise strategic stakes**
Google's reported $200B financing arrangement for Anthropic is one of the largest AI investment commitments on record and warrants scrutiny on structure, dilution, and regulatory treatment. Simultaneously, Anthropic is building an in-house chip design team — a direct threat to third-party GPU and accelerator revenue streams and a signal that vertical integration in AI infrastructure is accelerating. Bankers advising semiconductor clients should model customer concentration risk accordingly.

## Deal flow

Amazon issued a bumper debt offering, adding supply to IG tech credit. Visa's pending $2.4B acquisition of BioCatch extends the fintech-AI fraud-detection theme. Bending Spoons' pending $1.28B Airtable acquisition prices at a steep discount to the 2021 peak valuation of $11B, a useful down-round comparable for SaaS repricing conversations. The Google/Broadcom $150B AI chip commitment remains pending and continues to dominate infrastructure deal sizing benchmarks.

## Watching

Samsung is the highest-velocity spike in coverage (score 65), driven by zHBM launch news and Apple's failed CXMT gambit reinforcing Samsung's memory pricing power — watch for analyst target revisions. CoreWeave earnings and new capacity disclosures are an imminent catalyst for AI infrastructure sentiment and private cloud comps. Meta faces material regulatory risk in India over ad-review failures; monitor for spillover into EU proceedings.

## Three things that matter

1. **IonQ pays $1.8B for SkyWater, making the biggest vertical integration bet in quantum computing to date.**
Acquiring a semiconductor foundry gives IonQ control over quantum chip manufacturing, compressing its dependence on third-party fabs and potentially accelerating yield improvements. For comps, this is a capital-intensive strategic pivot that will pressure near-term FCF and likely require follow-on financing; watch whether the equity base can absorb the dilution at current quantum-sector multiples.

2. **Palantir surges 25% on earnings — AI software re-rating continues.**
The best single-day gain since February 2024 signals the market is aggressively repricing AI software names on demonstrated revenue traction, not just narrative. 3. **Anthropic locks in $10B compute deal with Nvidia-backed Volta Infra.**
A $10B infrastructure commitment from a frontier AI lab — structured as compute supply rather than a traditional equity raise — represents a new financing template for AI capex. For bankers, this raises questions about how similar off-balance-sheet compute arrangements should be treated in leverage and valuation analyses across the sector.

Bending Spoons is acquiring Airtable for $1.28B, a steep markdown from its $11B 2021 peak — a clean data point on no-code SaaS valuation compression that will inform any comparable process. Visa's pending $2.4B acquisition of fraud-detection AI firm BioCatch is progressing. Volta's $10B compute partnership with Anthropic has been added to the tracker as a pending private deal. 3. **알파벳, AI 개발 지연 및 현금 흐름 우려 관련 증권 사기 조사 직면.** 정식 조사가 개시됨에 따라 알파벳 이사회는 공시 의무가 발생하며, 이는 전략적 유연성을 제약할 수 있습니다. 구글 클라우드 관련 딜을 검토 중인 인수자 및 파트너사 — Oracle이 방금 발표한 협력 확대 건 포함 — 는 상대방 실사 과정에서 소송 리스크를 반드시 반영해야 합니다.

Nscale의 Anyscale(Ray 프레임워크) 인수는 이번 거래 중 전략적으로 가장 주목할 만한 건입니다. 네오클라우드 사업자가 AI 컴퓨트 스택 전반에 걸쳐 수직 통합을 추진한 이번 사례는, 여타 인프라 플레이어들이 따를 수밖에 없는 템플릿이 될 것입니다. 엔비디아의 SSI 50억 달러 투자는 아직 미확정 상태이며, 확인될 경우 추론 아키텍처 진화에 대응해 GPU 생태계 지위를 방어하는 랜드마크급 전략적 지출이 될 것입니다.
